verdict.rationale: Lago's self-hosted Docker deployment option (lago-docs-11) implies a customer could choose the physical location of their own infrastructure, giving indirect control over data residency, but there is no explicit documentation of region selection, data-residency guarantees, or multi-region hosting options for the managed cloud offering. missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, documentation of managed-cloud data locations, compliance statements (e.g. GDPR data residency) tied to specific regions.
